plan.title: Reject Vendor Bid with Re-bid Allowed

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the buyer can act on a submitted bid.
Open the bid-rejection confirmation dialog from the vendor bid controls.
Assert that the rejection dialog opened.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid

steps.note: Check the dialog's rejection confirmation text.
Open the stage's Rejected Bids list to inspect the recorded rejection.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Assert that the rejection record contains the entered reason.
